judgment.notes: The complete parameter and H boundary is faithful: positive integer dimensions are represented by n,m:ℕ with 1≤n∧1≤m; u has arbitrary real-time values but smoothness only where t>0; q is one fixed Euclidean vector with norm one. H004 quantifies every spatial point and positive time. H005 retains pointwise ∃a:ℝ for the same u and its real time/spatial derivatives, imposing no regularity or global choice of a. H006 retains ∀s,t with 0<s<t, an existential compact C depending on the interval, and equality to that same q outside C at every r∈Icc s t, including endpoints. Real endpoints are already finite. No additional typeclass or structure premise restricts these objects. The domain is nonempty and the assumptions admit u=q in every allowed dimension, so no vacuity was introduced. Expanding helper dependencies gives the accepted boundaries: R001 uses H001,H002,H004,H005; R002 uses H001,H002,H003,H006; R003 and R004 use H001,H002,N002 plus available library results; R005 uses H001,H002,N001–N004 plus the mean value theorem. T003 is internal to R002; T001 is internal to R001. Window is produced by T004, and the measure identity is produced by T011; neither is a new external H. Every conditional T input has an earlier producer, and T014 closes through T013 rather than leaving its hypothesis at the final source boundary. No background note is promoted to an assumption.
